::: {.hero}
# Hamza Rabi {.title}

::: {.hero-lead}
I build products and find out quickly whether they work. Four shipped end to
end, from customer interviews through launch, instrumentation, and the decision
to double down or shut it down.
:::

Two years founding and shipping my own products across generative AI,
marketplaces, and consumer iOS. Before that, two and a half years embedded in
product teams at [talabat](https://www.talabat.com), defining the metrics and
running the tests behind launches across eight MENA markets.

::: {.availability}
Open to product manager, product owner, and founding roles. [hamza-rabi@outlook.com](mailto:hamza-rabi@outlook.com)
:::

:::

::: {.capabilities}

::: {.capability}
[Discovery & validation]{.cap-title}

Customer interviews, prototypes, and launches that test the assumption rather
than decorate it. I onboarded restaurant partners in person, and I shut down a
product with 23,000 monthly visitors once the unit economics stopped adding up.
:::

::: {.capability}
[Ship and iterate]{.cap-title}

Four products taken from idea to the App Store and to production: a generative
AI SaaS, a three-sided marketplace, and privacy-first iOS apps. Design, build,
launch, support, repeat.
:::

::: {.capability}
[Decide with evidence]{.cap-title}

Instrumentation, funnels, retention, and A/B tests. I define the metrics and
read them myself instead of waiting in an analytics queue, which is usually the
difference between iterating this week and next quarter.
:::
